question: Related Questions Q. Difference in the number of talaq 2267 views Q. if muslim sunni person is married to muslim sunni girl and she forces him to divorce her in english court. he is forced into this matter and made by court to sign divorce documents. The judge grants divorce degree. But he has never given islamic divorce (talak). He still wants his wife . what is the islam says. Are they divorced islamicall or not. If the want to compromise and want to live together (which they both wanted) can they do it what the sharia says. 1828 views Q. Is a divorce issued by an English court based on false claims of separation and mutual consent valid according to Shariah? 1820 views Q. Divorce 1729 views Q. Can you please get clarified my following masla from Mufi sahib. I have been married for 2 years. For the last two months there has been quarrel with my wife on very small issues. Actually, my parents stay in a village and I stay with my wife in a city where I do job. We generally visit my parent 2-3 times in a year for 5-7 days. Recently, when we were at my parent place on a small issue my wife told -"Mujku thumharey maa baap ki zarorat nahi". I got anger and replied -"phir mujku bhi teri zaroorat nahi.". This happens two times. After that I left her at her parents' place. Presently, now and then on phone we start fighting and in anger I used to tell words like -" Hum doono ko nahi ban rah hai", "tho jaa"..etc. I never uttered any word like "talaq". I have following 4 questions- 1. Will the words I told to my wife going to impact my Nikha? 2.Sometimes it comes to my mind to give talaq to my wife, but actually I do not want. And there is always something like wasawasa in my mind that I told talaq in my mind, but I never uttered any word from my mouth even when I was alone. Will this effect my nikha? 3. When somebody spells "talaaq" to wife in her absence, ie no one is around, Is talaq still valid? 4. What should be the minimum sound needed to utter "talaq", so that talaq is valid? 2810 views Q. R.B.Dhekiajuly on 31/08/08 I marred according to Islamic law. I and my wife love each other very much. But her parents do not like me. So they, by any means, want Divorce. Some days ago her parents in my absence took her to their home with false vows. After that they put pressure on her for divorce. Accordingly, she wanted divorce. But I did not it. I only replied in Assamese through SMS (TUMI JI AKARE MUK ERI JABO BISARISA TAR KARONE MOI TUMAK TALAQ DIA JORURI, KINTU, TUMAR NISINA TUMAR PORIALE U BISARILE MOI TALAQ DIBOLOI RAJI ASU) {Translate to English} ?whatever you have wanted,?? It is necessary for me to divorce you. If your family wants like you, I am ready?. On another day I told her, ?if you go to your parental house without my wish, I shall divorce you? Has it become divorce? I love her and will love for ever. They have forcefully want to got her married to another person. Is not this an act against Islamic law? In hope for answer from your side. ZAZAK ALLAH. 1934 views Q. This is to help me for a reason, i recently got married and after two months of marrige my husband starts quarreling & beating and doubting me of having an affier,even one day he tried to kill me by choking me, after that I went to my mother's house. On this he starts to say in all my nearby realatives and surrounding that he has divorced me, now we are not together, we are now seprated, reapetedly even when my brother went to him to discuss he said that he dont want to discuss any thing & he has given TALAQ to me, Then after some time he filed a case to call me back in court , but he himself not attended any hiearing and never shows any interest in solving the matter. That case got dissmissed by court. Now he has filled a case aginest me for divorce and is asking for rs 300000 for out of court divorce and is refusing to pay my meher, now it has passed abot 1.5 yrs my family is getting impatient whether i am married or divorced , should i start my period of iddah, or shuld i get ready for this out of court settelment by paying rs 300000 & geting divorce paper signed. now he only talkes on phone & it comes to my knowledge from some relible source of his side(with photograph of marrige) that he has married some other girl in delhi & told her parents that he has divorced me . Kindly Guide me shuld i consider his declairing in public as divorce & ask for meher, or shuld i consider my self married. 2046 views Q. talaq 1693 views Q. Talaq 2160 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 35939 Country: India Title: I got married on 06.07.2002 with one of my cousin named Masuma Khatun, soon after marriage the conflict occurred both of our family Question: I, Masud Ar Rashid residing at South Kazipara, Barasat, 24 Parganas (N), Kolkata -700124 son of Md. Momin. I have an earnest request that I desire to know the fatwa against the marriage status describe below. I got married on 06.07.2002 with one of my cousin named Masuma Khatun, residing at North Kazipara, Barasat, 24 Parganas(N), Kolkata -700124, daughter of Syed Mosaraf Ali, as per the regulation of Muslim Personal Law. Soon after marriage the conflict occurred both of our family. She was staying at her father's house since marriage, on that time there was a relation with both of us. I usually visited their house to meet her. After two years that is early March of 2004 we got stay separated and never meet again till early week of June, 2008 and on that time conflict again raised. I had sent her divorce paper according to Muslim Personal Law on 07.08.2008 but she refused the same and remained silent till middle of September, 2010. During this time she claimed or has gone for any legal action. Answer ID: 35939 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 160/91/D=1433) She was divorced after you send written talaqnama. If she did not receive then too the talaq took place (immediately after you wrote). Whatever talaq i.e. raja'i, bainah or three talaqs you wrote, it took place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
